First, in `src/agent/loop.ts`, the web-fetch spiral guardrail treats repeated requests to the same host as a loop; allow distinct `web_fetch` URLs on the same host while keeping the per-turn and per-session request caps. Second, loop and research guardrail feedback should stay in the agent's context but be quiet in the interactive chat: mark such blocked results so the tool view (`src/ui/tool-view.tsx`) renders them as quiet skips, and stop showing internal loop-recovery notices in the chat.

The regression test(s) for this change are already in the worktree: `src/agent/loop-guardrails.test.ts`, `src/ui/tool-view.test.tsx`. Read them to see the exact API and behaviour expected, then implement the change so they pass. Do not modify the test files; they are restored before verification. Run the tests with `npx tsx --test src/agent/loop-guardrails.test.ts src/ui/tool-view.test.tsx` and `npm run typecheck` before you finish.
